description: HCA Healthcare, Inc. is one of the leading health care services companies in the United States, and at December 31, 2025 it operated 190 hospitals, comprised of 179 general acute care hospitals, seven behavioral hospitals and four rehabilitation hospitals, as well as 121 freestanding ambulatory surgery centers and 31 freestanding endoscopy centers, with facilities located in 19 states and England. Its primary objective is to provide a comprehensive array of quality health care services in the most cost-effective manner possible, and certain of its affiliates provide a variety of management services to its health care facilities, including patient safety programs, ethics and compliance programs, national supply contracts, equipment purchasing and leasing contracts, accounting, financial and clinical systems, governmental reimbursement assistance, construction planning and coordination, information technology systems and solutions, legal counsel, human resources services and internal audit services.
